passage:
Every new student at Hill School receives a guide written by older students. It does not only list rules. It gives advice.
One page says, "The third-floor water machine is coldest." Another says, "Do not worry if you get lost in Building B. Everyone does." There is also a list of teachers who open classrooms during lunch for quiet study.
The guide began after several new students said they felt nervous but did not know whom to ask.
Older students update it every year. They remove old information and add new tips.
The guide shows that welcoming someone is not only saying hello. It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
